instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of an indoor room near a window. On the left, the woman with curly hair (R1) in a blue corduroy jacket and green pants sits cross-legged, looking concernedly at the woman with straight dark hair (R2) on the right. The woman with straight dark hair (R2) wears a dark green sweater and jeans, sitting with her chin resting on her hand and looking down sadly. The woman with curly hair (R1) places her left hand comfortingly on the other woman's shoulder. Soft natural light filters through the window behind them, casting cool tones over the scene.

R1 is the concerned comforter while R2 is the sad recipient
